name: Facet
notes: New widgets: Spotify (album art, progress, play/pause, skip, shuffle and repeat; works with the Spotify app, no sign-in), a Control Center (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, night light and dark mode toggles, now playing, time, CPU and memory, brightness and volume sliders, and quick buttons), and Recent folders. Add them with the Widget button in Facet or from the tray.
